The '''NOVA40 Plasma Grenade''' was a type of [[Plasma grenade/Legends|plasma grenade]] produced by [[Kirgo Blastworks/Legends|Kirgo Blastworks]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
The NOVA40 contained a store of blaster gas comparable to the load of a blaster pistol; when primed, an [[XCiter/Legends|XCiter]] unit converted the blaster gas contained within to a highly energetic state. After three to sixty seconds, as selected by the user, the grenade activates the gas with a laser charge, detonating in a highly explosive fashion. The resulting explosion was very similar in appearance and effect to a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], but more powerful than even a heavy blaster, and dispersed over a much larger area.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
